ns2:section.sectionText: This course develops career readiness competencies of LAS students as they engage in professional experiences (e.g., internship, service learning, volunteer, part-time job). Classes are offered virtually and in the evenings in order to connect with students outside of work experiences. This is a hybrid learning experience, requiring 4 synchronous Zoom meetings and 4 asynchronous topical “lessons” that apply career management skills to hands-on learning experiences. This course is open to bachelor’s degree seeking students in LAS who have identified a professional experience that dedicates at least 60 hours of time over a prolonged engagement (for example, engaging in a fall semester experience that spans at least 10 weeks, at a minimum of 6 hours/week). The course must be completed in the term in which the professional experience is completed.
